content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where Stripe and PayPal are severely restricted, digital creators face a significant infrastructure problem: how to host and sell digital products without relying on unavailable or unaffordable platforms. This is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-every-4|github]] Pages comes in, offering a free solution for hosting digital product stores, making it possible to sell ebooks, courses, and templates without Stripe or PayPal.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free service that allows users to host static websites directly from their GitHub repositories. For digital creators, this means having a reliable and cost-effective way to host their digital product stores, without the need for third-party platforms that charge high fees. By using GitHub Pages, creators can maintain full control over their store and products, ensuring a seamless and secure experience for their customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-now[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-14|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-integration-static-site-crypto-15|The Real]] behind GitHub Pages is straightforward: users create a GitHub repository for their digital product store, add their website files, and configure GitHub Pages to host the site. This setup allows for automatic deployment of the website, making it easily accessible to customers. Additionally, by integrating services like NOWPayments, creators can enable automatic crypto payment processing, further streamlining the sales process and reducing fees, such as the 10% charged by Gumroad, compared to NOWPayments' 0.5% fee.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. By providing a free and reliable hosting option, GitHub Pages empowers these creators to sell their digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates, without relying on platforms that charge exorbitant fees or require significant setup costs. This infrastructure sovereignty is crucial for maintaining control over one's business and ensuring long-term viability.
GitHub Pages offers a free and reliable hosting option for digital product stores.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components that make this solution work include GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. These tools work together seamlessly to provide a comprehensive digital commerce stack, enabling creators to sell their products securely and efficiently. By leveraging these components, creators can focus on developing their products, rather than worrying about the underlying infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a digital product store using GitHub Pages, creators can start by setting up a GitHub repository and configuring GitHub Pages. Next, they can integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. With these components in place, creators can upload their digital products and start selling immediately, all while maintaining full control over their store and products. This streamlined process enables creators to get started quickly and focus on growing their business.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use GitHub Pages to host their digital product store and integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This setup allows for automatic payment verification and secure transactions, all while avoiding the high fees associated with traditional payment platforms. By using this infrastructure, creators can retain more of their earnings, such as the $921 retained at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, compared to using Gumroad.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% fees, compared to Gumroad's 10%.

This kit can be purchased directly from the shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, offering a one-stop solution for creators to establish their sovereign digital commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital product store using GitHub Pages, follow these steps: set up a GitHub repository, configure GitHub Pages, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, upload digital products, and configure automatic payment verification. With these steps complete, creators can start selling their products securely and efficiently, all while maintaining full control over their store and earnings. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to access the necessary tools and resources.
